Principle 16: My Other Dream Job
I have seen on TV and read about many successful people
such as Bill Gates, Ban-Gi-Moon and Angelina Jolie.
These people have influenced me a lot in one way or another.
A few years ago, Queen Elizabeth II came to Korea.
She had an interpreter with her who was very professional.
Her ability to interpret so well had a great affect on me.
It has impressed me enough to want to become an interpreter.
There are many reasons why I want to become an interpreter.
First, English is the most widely used language in the world.
So, I know that English is important.
Second, I want to translate many interesting books
so that many more people can enjoy reading them.
Furthermore, I want to write books in English, too.
Another reason is that I want to interpret for people
who can’t speak English.
Finally, if I go to another country, the people might not understand Korean,
so I must learn to speak English well so that I can communicate with them
comfortably.
In order to fulfill my dreams, I have to do many things.
First of all, I will study English everyday,
by practicing listening and speaking.
I will do this by going to an English Academy every day.
When I grow up, I plan on going abroad
to study English in another country
so that I can listen and speak like a native speaker of English.
If I really want to become a great interpreter,
I need to work hard at improving English from now on.
